Fellows receive professional experience, structured learning, and a monthly stipend.

schemename: Grishm Kaleen Dhan Ke Badle Dalhan, Tilhan, Makka Fasal ko Protsahan Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme was launched on April 30, 2014,  under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology Department, Chhattisgarh. The scheme aims to promote the cultivation of pulses, oilseeds, and maize as an alternative to summer rice, helping to conserve groundwater.

schemename: Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan)
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide short-term working capital loans for livestock activities by offering eligible livestock farmers interest-subsidized loans for operational purposes through banks.

schemename: Assistance Towards Sugarcane Supplied By The Sugarcane Growers
briefdescription: The scheme aims to assist Sugarcane Growers to take up sugarcane cultivation in the State of Goa. It provides financial support to farmers cultivating sugarcane, paid based on actual tonnage supplied at the factory weighbridge as per the Fair & Remunerative Price.

schemename: Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to victims or families affected by wild animal attacks in both urban and rural areas through timely monetary compensation.

schemename: Rotavator/Thresher Machine Equipment Assistance Scheme
briefdescription: The scheme aims to support BPL Scheduled Tribe farmers in tribal areas by providing financial assistance to purchase rotavators and thresher machines.

schemename: State Millet Mission
briefdescription: The mission aims to promote millet cultivation, ensure fair prices for farmers, and strengthen food security in the state. It seeks to support farmers, particularly in mountain districts, by procuring millet crops such as Mandua and Jhangora at the minimum support price through cooperative groups.

schemename: Allotment of Shops in Kisan Bazaar
briefdescription: The scheme aims to facilitate trade in products other than agricultural produce by providing commercial shops in Kisan Bazaars. The shops are allotted to eligible residents of Uttarakhand through public notices published in newspapers and displayed at public places.

schemename: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Production Programme
briefdescription: The scheme aims to enhance the production and economic status of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe small and marginal farmers. It provides Foundation or Certified Grade I seeds for high-yielding food grain crops with a 75% subsidy to registered farmers operating near Government agricultural farms.

schemename: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Exchange Programme
briefdescription: The scheme aims to increase agricultural productivity and production for SC/ST farmers who cannot afford improved seeds. It provides high-yielding improved seed varieties, up to one hectare, in exchange for existing crop or seed, backed by a 75% subsidy with a maximum limit of ₹1,500/-.

schemename: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization - Uttarakhand
briefdescription: The scheme aims to encourage farm mechanization purchasing and providing 50% subsidy/financial assistance to SC/ST, small and marginal, and women farmers (of all categories), while 40% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to other (large) farmers.

schemename: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) for Custom Hiring Centres / Big Farmers - Uttarakhand
briefdescription: Under this scheme, individual large farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, self-help groups, and custom hiring centres in the state can purchase agricultural equipment at a subsidized rate, with the Government of India providing a maximum subsidy of 40%.

schemename: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana - Uttarakhand
briefdescription: The scheme aims to promote & support organic farming among farmers in Uttarakhand. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹9,000/- per hectare to farmers for the purchase of organic inputs, including seeds, compost, green manure, biofertilizers, biopesticides, neem oil, etc.

schemename: Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to farmers in the event of loss or damage to crops, livestock, or agricultural land caused by fire, flood, or heavy rains in the notified areas of the state.

schemename: Madhya Pradesh Lok Vaniki Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide for the management of tree covered areas located on private land and revenue land under the MP Public Forestry Act, 2001. The scheme benefits landowners, Gram Panchayats, or Gram Sabhas by allowing them to undertake the scientific management of their tree covered areas.

schemename: Investment Grant for Farmers with More than 2 Hectares of Agricultural Land
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers owning more than 2 hectares of agricultural land who suffer crop losses due to natural disasters.

schemename: Jal Hauj
briefdescription: The objective of the Jal Hauj scheme is to promote sustainable water management practices and address water scarcity issues by facilitating the construction of water harvesting structures.

schemename: Fasal Pradarshan
briefdescription: Under this scheme, the Agriculture Department organizes field and crop demonstrations to showcase advanced crop production methods and the latest technologies to farmers.

schemename: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
briefdescription: Under this scheme, 50 chicks of 10 days of age from the Government Hatchery Farm along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.

schemename: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General)
briefdescription: This scheme is a credit linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunities, the unemployed persons will be assisted by way of establishing Sheep or Goat Units (15 female+1 male) and Piggery Unit (10 female+1 male).

nodalministryname: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemename: Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry
briefdescription: The Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying introduced the National Livestock Mission as umbrella scheme. The "Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry" is the realigned National Livestock Mission, which is the scheme's sub-mission.

schemename: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
briefdescription: Under this scheme, a resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of two milch animals. The subsidy can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units with two milch animals.

schemename: Destitute Agricultural Labourers Pension Scheme
briefdescription: The "Destitute Agricultural Labourers Pension Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give pensions of ₹1,000/- to destitute agricultural labourers of 60 years and above and dhoti, saree supplied on festivals.

schemename: Nalkoop Khanan Yojana- Madhya Pradesh
briefdescription: Under this scheme, farmers from SC and ST categories are eligible for a subsidy covering 75% of the unit cost (up to ₹25,000/-) for digging a tube well and 75% of the unit cost (up to ₹15,000/-) for the successful installation of a tube well submersible pump.

schemename: Micro Nutrient Spray
briefdescription: The “Micro Nutrient Spray” scheme provides a 50% subsidy or ₹70/- per hectare to eligible farmers, with a focus on ensuring benefits to SC/ST and women farmers.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Strawberry Vikas Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to promote strawberry cultivation across 20 districts in Bihar. It provides subsidies on seedlings, packaging materials, and equipment to support farmers in enhancing strawberry production.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Aam Vikas Yojana
briefdescription: The Scheme aims to expand plantain cultivation across all districts in Bihar. Farmers can receive subsidies for up to 10 acres and access high-quality tissue-cultured plants for cultivation.

schemename: Aaloo Ke Kufri Chipsona-1 Prabhed Ke Kshetra Vistaar Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to increase the production of Kufri Chipsona variety suitable for potato processing in Bihar by expanding its area and to increase the income of farmers by promoting processing.

schemename: Beej Masaale Ki Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to encourage the farmers to cultivate identified seed spices such as coriander and fenugreek keeping in mind their medicinal and nutritional properties.

schemename: Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment
briefdescription: The "Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment" by the Animal Husbandry Department, Madhya Pradesh promotes milk production and employment. Trained Gausevaks get an honorarium of ₹4,000 and equipment worth ₹18,000.

schemename: Gopal Incentive Scheme
briefdescription: The "Gopal Incentive Scheme" by the Animal Husbandry Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, promotes the rearing of Indian high-breed cattle and boosts milk production, benefiting animal breeders and livestock farmers with access to Indian advanced breed cows.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Jan-Van Scheme
briefdescription: The Mukhyamantri Jan-Van Scheme aims to promote tree plantation on private lands in Jharkhand to enhance farmers' income, conserve the environment, and reduce pressure on notified forests. Farmers are encouraged to plant trees on their lands with incentives covering 75% of plantation and maintenance

schemename: Supply of Kadaknath Chicks on Subsidy
briefdescription: The scheme "Supply of Kadaknath Chicken on Grant" aims to improve the economic condition of beneficiaries through poultry farming and protect and promote the Kadaknath breed. Beneficiaries receive 40 chicks along with food grains, medicine, and transportation support for 28 days.

schemename: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For SSI Unit Loan and Other NFS Activities
briefdescription: This scheme provides financial assistance for SSI unit loans and other Non-Farm Sector (NFS) activities through District Central Cooperative Banks and their branches.

schemename: Distribution of Soil Health Card
briefdescription: Under the “Distribution of Soil Health Card” scheme, Soil health cards will be distributed to all the farmers who have offered the soil sample for testing by paying a prescribed fee of ₹5/- each for Macro and Micronutrient testing.

schemename: Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm
briefdescription: The "Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, supports livestock owners in establishing dairy farms with up to 12 milch animals.

schemename: Millet Development Scheme
briefdescription: The "Millet Development Scheme" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat, aims to promote millet cultivation in Gujarat by organizing promotional activities, expos, processing units, demonstrations(seed/input kit ), and taluka-level melas.

schemename: Establishment of Goat Unit (10 +1)
briefdescription: The "Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1)" scheme by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to promote the social and economic upliftment of goat breeders by encouraging goat breeding and genetic improvement through pure breeding.

schemename: Trainning Scheme for Horticulture Skill Development to Landless farm labour at Centre of Excelence of Department
briefdescription: The "Training Scheme for Horticulture Skill Development to Landless Farm Labour at Centre of Excellence of Department" aims to provide skill development training in horticulture to landless farm labourers through the Centres of Excellence.

schemename: Scheme to Provide Assistance in Cow Maintenance Expenses to Farmers Practicing Completely Natural Farming Based on Indigenous Cows
briefdescription: This scheme provides financial assistance for the maintenance of one indigenous cow to farmers who practice completely natural farming methods using native cows.

schemename: Capital Subsidy Scheme for Setting Up Solar Plant in Milk Cooperatives in Gujarat State (Tribal Area)
briefdescription: The scheme aims to promote renewable energy and reduce electricity expenses. Through this scheme, a 75% subsidy is provided for setting up solar plants (1KW to 40KW) in milk cooperative societies in tribal areas.

schemename: A Program to Provide 90 Percent Assistance in Planting Material of Horticultural Fruit Crops
briefdescription: This scheme offers 90% financial assistance to farmers for purchasing planting materials of fruit crops to promote horticulture.

schemename: To Provide Interest Subvention to Fishermen of the State at the Rate of 4% to the Beneficiaries Kishan Credit Card
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide 4% interest subvention to the fishermen in Gujarat on timely repayment of short-term loans taken through the Kisan Credit Card.

schemename: To Provide Financial Assistance to the Farmers Practicing Natural Farming Under the Completely Chemical Free Dang District
briefdescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to farmers practicing natural farming in the completely chemical-free Dang district to promote sustainable agriculture, increase productivity, and ensure environmental conservation.

schemename: Scheme of Production of Domestic Indigenous Certified Seed of Cotton Varieties
briefdescription: The "Scheme of Production of Domestic Indigenous Certified Seed of Cotton Varieties"  introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, aims to promote the cultivation and production of local cotton seed varieties across Gujarat.

schemename: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)
briefdescription: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)" provides 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed to General Category livestock owners after parturition to support cattle health, increase milk production, and enhance calf development.

schemename: PMMSY: Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture - Haryana
briefdescription: The subsidy for Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for saline/alkaline water aquaculture in newly created water bodies to expand fisheries production in Haryana.

schemename: PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to promote cage fish farming. It provides grants per unit to the individuals and groups for sustainable aquaculture practices.

schemename: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Solar System for fish/shrimp culture
briefdescription: Under this scheme, subsidies on solar systems for fish/shrimp culture are provided to eligible fish and shrimp farmers. The subsidy is given at 60% of the total project cost, or ₹30,000 per kW, whichever is lower. The maximum subsidy is limited to 30 kW for shrimp farmers and 10 kW for fish farmers.

schemename: "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
briefdescription: The scheme aims to ensure long term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and incentivize Orthodox tea production over Crush, Tear, Curl tea. It provides interest subvention, production subsidies, plant & machinery subsidies, tax holidays to tea plantations and manufacturing units in Assam.

schemename: Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa
briefdescription: “Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up Breeding Units and Rearing Units. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.

schemename: Spices Development Ginger, Turmeric, Black Pepper, Cardamom, Coriander, Cinnamon and Chillies
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to encourage farmers to produce good quality and diseased-free planting materials and to grow improved varieties of high-yielding spices.

schemename: Development and Maintenance of Orchard Cum Horti Nurseries
briefdescription: The scheme has been launched for the production and multiplication of good, high-yielding, diseased free planting materials in the Government farms for distribution to farmers through the District Horticulture Officer.

schemename: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Fuel (Petrol) to the Fishermen for Operation of Out Board Motors
briefdescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Fuel (Petrol) to the Fishermen for Operation of Out Board Motors” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, a subsidy of ₹30 per Litre on a maximum consumption of 1700 Litre of Petrol is provided to fishermen.

schemename: Tuber Crops Potato, Tapioca, Colocasia
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to boost up production and productivity of potato per unit area by providing quality HYV seeds, and equipment at a 50% subsidy.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
schemename: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Consolidation of Coffee
briefdescription: The scheme "Consolidation of Coffee" aims to increase the productivity of the existing coffee holdings by gap filling or rejuvenation, followed by improved cultivation methods such as application of compost, bush management, shade management, pest and disease control, etc.

schemename: Distribution of Vegetable Seeds Minikit & Fruits Minikit at Free of Cost
briefdescription: “Distribution of Vegetable Seeds Minikit & Fruits Minikit at Free of Cost" was launched by the Dept of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, UT of Puducherry. All the horticulture growers of rural & urban areas are provided with vegetable seeds minikit & fruits minikit worth ₹250/‐ free of cost.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
schemename: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee
briefdescription: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee" by the Coffee Board, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, aims to facilitate afforestation in the Jhum lands and help settle the tribals on a permanent footing.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemename: Kera Suraksha Insurance Scheme
briefdescription: The ‘Kera Suraksha Insurance Scheme’ is a comprehensive Group Personal Accident Insurance Scheme, implemented by Coconut Development Board in association with Public Insurance companies for Coconut Tree Climbers/Neera Technicians/Coconut Harvesters.

schemename: Rythu Bima Scheme
briefdescription: Rythu Bandhu Farmer Group Life  Insurance Scheme for Farmers” is a life insurance scheme by the Government of Telangana that provides insurance coverage to the nominee of a farmer in case of the farmer’s death. It is free for farmers and is implemented through LIC.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemename: Students Ready
briefdescription: The Student Rural Entrepreneurship Awareness Development Yojana (READY)  was launched by Hon'ble Prime Minister on 25 July 2015.

schemename: Ganga Kalyana Scheme
briefdescription:
Ganga Kalyana Scheme is implemented by Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation Limited.
This scheme is a fully subsidized scheme, bore wells, pumps and electrification are provided to minorities, and small and marginal farmers living in rural areas.

schemename: Guru Shishya Parampara
briefdescription: A scheme called "Guru Shishya Parampara Scheme" to preserve and promote rare and vanishing art forms on Classical or Folk/Tribal so that the young talents be nurtured to acquire skills in their chosen field of art art under the able guidance of Gurus

schemename: AGR-50 Scheme-Assistance To Purchase Tractors
briefdescription: The scheme “AGR-50 Scheme-Assistance to Purchase Tractors” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat in the year 2011-12. The scheme was implemented for the farmers to help in buying the tractor in the state.

schemename: AGR 3 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For ST Farmers
briefdescription: The scheme “AGR 3 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme for ST Farmers” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

schemename: AGR 4 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For SC Farmers
briefdescription: The scheme “AGR 4 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme for SC Farmers” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

schemename: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Divyang People
briefdescription: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Divyang People” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of Divyang poultry farmers through scientific poultry farming training.

schemename: Saur Sujala Yojana
briefdescription: The Saur Sujala Yojana is to set up solar irrigation pumps for the irrigation needs of the farmers. The scheme has been started on November 01, 2016, with the aim of empowering the farmers by providing irrigation pumps to the farmers at subsidized rates.

schemename: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit For Weaker Section
briefdescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit for Weaker Section” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of weaker section people of the society.

schemename: Semi-Commercial Duck Farming
briefdescription: The scheme “Semi-Commercial Duck Farming” started under the State Sector Scheme "Encouragement of Commercial Poultry Entrepreneur and Promotion of Backyard Poultry Production" to support small entrepreneurs in setting up Duck farms with a capacity of 1000 ducks.

schemename: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Schedule Caste
briefdescription: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Schedule Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers of Scheduled Caste by scientific poultry farming training.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers
schemename: ICRO Amrit Internship Programme
briefdescription: The IPL Centre for Rural Outreach (ICRO) has launched ICRO Amrit Internship Programme focused on youth productivity for prosperity. The interns will be placed at the headquarters and Regional Offices of NPC/ IPL. The duration of the internship will be 3 months initially, renewable up to four times.

schemename: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana
briefdescription: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana is a scheme of the Government of Chhattisgarh for the farmers. This scheme was launched on 21 May 2020, on the death anniversary of Rajiv Gandhi.

schemename: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Tribe
briefdescription: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Tribe” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat.

schemename: Popularisation Of Fishery Machinery/ Equipments/ Implements” For Intensive Aquaculture In Odisha For The Financial Year 2021-22
briefdescription: The aim of the "Popularisation of Fishery Machinery/ Equipments/ Implements” for Intensive Aquaculture in Odisha for the Financial Year 2021-22" scheme is to provide subsidy support to farmers/ fishers.

schemename: Ghar Ghar Aushodhi Yojana
briefdescription: Rajasthan government has planned a new scheme called Rajasthan Ghar Ghar Aushadhi Yojana to promote the use of Ayurvedic and medicinal herbs across the state.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemename: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
briefdescription: In order to promote soil test analysis in a campaign mode and to create awareness among farmers about soil health for judicious use of chemical fertilisers, organic manure, the component of “Setting of Village-level Soil Testing Laboratories” is being implemented under the scheme.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemename: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
briefdescription: Soil Health Card is designed to give each farmer soil nutrient status of his/her holding and advice him/her on the dosage of fertilizers and also the needed soil amendments, that s/he should apply to maintain soil health in the long run.

schemename: Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp
briefdescription: The project aims to enhance climate-resilience and profitability of smallholder farming systems in 15 project districts of Maharashtra through promotion of climate resilient technology and commodity value chain across approximately 5,000 drought-prone and/or sodicity/salinity affected villages.

schemeshorttitle: CHIEF MINISTER AGRICULTURE AND FOOD PROCESSING SCHEME
schemename: Chief Minister Agriculture and Food Processing Scheme
briefdescription: to encourage model technology based projects and quality enhancement of agriculture produce, to encourage exports, to create skill manpower for agro and food processing and employment generation through small and medium agro and food processing units in rural areas.

schemename: Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagvad Scheme
briefdescription: This scheme includes, Plantation of sixteen perennial horticulture crops. Farmer from Konkan division can avail benefit of 0.10 Hector  to 10.00 Hector  and rest Of Maharashtra 0.20 Hector  to 6.00 Hector

schemename: "Protected Cultivation" Component of "Establishment of New Gardens (Area Expansion)" Scheme
briefdescription: Through this scheme, the farmers are provided Poly House, Shade Net House (Tubular Structure), Plastic Mulching at subsidised rates for practising Protected Cultivation. In Puducherry, this scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, Union Territory of Puducherry.

schemename: Atma Nirbhar Bagwani Yojana
briefdescription: The schemes are part of the Atma Nirbhar program announced during the Budget session held in February this year. A total amount of Rs 120 crores – Rs 60 crores for each scheme has been allocated to the two concerned departments of Agriculture and Horticulture.

schemename: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Installation of Cage in Reservoir - Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to boost inland fish production and employment in fisheries. It provides financial assistance for cage installation in reservoirs to eligible beneficiaries.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes
briefdescription: The scheme aims to uplift Scheduled Caste beneficiaries. Through this scheme, sheep and goat units are provided free of cost, along with veterinary assistance, to eligible unemployed Scheduled Caste families.

schemename: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Establishment of Seed Garden
briefdescription: The scheme component "Establishment of Seed Garden" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase oil palm production in Gujarat and reduce imports by establishing seed gardens through infrastructure support to farmers.
tags: ['Edible Oil', 'Seed Orchard Infrastructure', 'Oil Palm Nursery Development', 'Farmer']

schemename: Assistance for Area Expansion in Fruit crops
briefdescription: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion in Fruit Crops" aims to promote fruit crop cultivation through financial assistance for high density and ultra-high density plantations, tissue culture bananas, and papayas to farmers across the state.
tags: ['Agriculture', 'Fruit Crop', 'High Density Plantation', 'Tissue Culture Banana', 'Papaya Cultivation', 'Farmer']

schemename: Teelu Rauteli Pension Scheme
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,200/- to male and female individuals above 18 years of age who have incurred a partial disability of 20% to 40% while performing agricultural activities.

schemename: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Drip Irrigation
briefdescription: The scheme component "Drip Irrigation" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase the production of oil palm in Gujarat and reduce imports from abroad by providing drip irrigation facilities to farmers under subsidy norms.

schemename: PMMSY: Construction of Ice Plant/Storage of Minimum 10 Tonne Capacity - Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the construction of ice plants/storage units of at least 10 tonne capacity, supporting fishermen and sellers to maintain fish in fresh and hygienic condition.

schemename: Decentralized People’s Nursery
briefdescription: The scheme aims to increase tree cover and support rural incomes by enabling individuals and institutions to raise tree seedlings. It offers financial assistance per seedling, with beneficiaries retaining ownership of the plants, encouraging commercial nursery activity.

schemename: Distribution of Seeds of more productions verities / Hybrids verities Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Distribution of Minor and Micro Elements - Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to enhance productivity for Adivasi farmers through the provision of subsidised seeds, fertilisers, and supporting agricultural inputs. Through this scheme, such inputs are provided to Scheduled Tribe farmers to boost crop yields and livelihoods.

schemename: Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY: Accidental death or Permanent Total Disability Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fishermen/fishermen's families in case of death or injury. Through this scheme, insurance coverage for death permanent partial disability is provided to eligible fishers.

schemename: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Field Demonstration (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to improve the agricultural production and livelihood of Scheduled Tribe farmers. Through this scheme, subsidies on seeds, fertilizers, and demonstrations are provided to tribal cultivators.

schemename: PMMSY: Insulated vehicles - Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for Insulated vehicles.

schemename: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to boost fish production, exports, and the safety of fishermen. Assistance is given for modernisation, insulated vehicles, and upgradation of fishing vessels to improve income and fish quality.
tags: ['Construction Of Plant', 'Storage', 'Fish', 'Fisherman', 'Fish Sellers', 'Upgradation Of Existing Fishing Vessels', 'Export']

schemename: Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for use of Micronutrients
briefdescription: The scheme “Development of Manures & Fertilizers" was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Goa. The "Assistance for use of Micronutrients" component of the scheme aims to address micronutrient deficiencies in the soil that affect crop productivity and ensure healthy crop growth.

schemename: Vats Palan Protsahan Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to improve Indian indigenous high-yielding cattle breeds by providing eligible livestock farmers with financial incentives and monthly support for calf maintenance.

schemename: Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for Construction/Installation of Biogas Plants
briefdescription: The scheme aims to effectively manage on-farm livestock waste to produce renewable energy through biogas units, converting animal waste into a sustainable energy source. The payment of the sanctioned subsidy is through the Electronic Clearance System (ECS).

schemename: Payment in the Owner-Occupied / Public Forestry Case
briefdescription: Under this scheme, farmers are enabled to sell teak and sal wood to the government at notified rates, ensuring fair compensation through timely e-payment.

schemename: Sheti Samrudhi Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to facilitate community level action for agriculture growth and management of natural resources. It offers financial assistance, wages for personnel, and funding for necessary office equipment for Tribal Farmers Co-operative.

schemename: Infrastructure Development Scheme for Dairy Co-operatives
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Dairy Co-operative Societies for their development, smooth functioning of business, and other allied activities, enabling them to become stable and create better infrastructure. The scheme provides financial support in the form of grant or subsidy.

schemename: Procurement of Food Grains From Farmers at Support Price
briefdescription: The scheme aims to ensure fair and assured prices for farmers by enabling direct government procurement of wheat, paddy, maize, and jowar from registered farmers at the centrally declared Minimum Support Price (MSP) along with any applicable state bonus during the designated procurement period.

schemename: Seed Grant
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide seeds to farmers at a concessional rate during Kisan Melas with a subsidy of up to 15%.

schemename: Balram Talab Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to conserve rainwater in fields to help farmers, ensuring water availability during irrigation and drought conditions. Farmers receive subsidies up to ₹1,00,000/- for pond construction.

schemename: Soil Resource Management and Inputs Quality Control
briefdescription: Through the scheme “Soil Resource Management and Inputs Quality Control", the farmers can give their soil and water samples to the soil testing lab for analysis and recommendation at completely free of cost.

schemename: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture Sub Scheme Horticulture Mission for North East and Himalayan Region- Meghalaya
briefdescription: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya to promote holistic growth of Horticulture sector thorough promotion, extension, post-harvest management, processing and marketing.

schemename: Horticulture Mission for North Eastern Hill Scheme- Meghalaya
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to improve productivity, quality planting material, canopy management of fruit trees, support marginal and small farmers, upscaling protected cultivation, and drip irrigation.

schemename: Agriculture Engineering (Mechanical) Scheme
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide agricultural machinery such as power tillers/ bulldozers/ tractors etc. on hiring at subsidised rate.

schemename: Basic Agriculture Training Centre Scheme
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide short-term vocational training for rural educated unemployed youths in agriculture and allied sectors to develop entrepreneurship skills and employment generation.

schemename: "Subsidy for Cultivation of Fodder Crops" Component of the "Crop Production Technology" Scheme
briefdescription: The "Subsidy for Cultivation of Fodder Crops" scheme was introduced by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, cash incentives are distributed to Farmers and Self Help Groups for undertaking fodder cultivation in the Puducherry region.

schemename: Drip Sanyantr
briefdescription: Under the Drip Sanyantr scheme, the government gives subsidies to farmers. There is an immense saving of water in this method. Under this method, water is applied drop by drop to the roots of the plants and wastage of water will negligible.

schemename: Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award
briefdescription: The scheme “Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat on 30.10.1995.

schemename: Rajiv Gandhi Krishak Sathi Sahayta Yojana
briefdescription: The Rajiv Gandhi Krishak Sathi Sahayta Yojana offers financial support to farmers, farmworkers, and market laborers who are accidentally injured or killed while working in agriculture or at agricultural markets.

schemename: Plastic Mulching
briefdescription: Under the Plastic Mulching scheme, the Rajasthan government provided subsidies to farmers. In this, the soil surface of the field is covered with plastic film. Farmer can also use crop residues for laying mulch.

schemename: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
briefdescription: A initiative of Rajasthan State for the farmer to protect crops from damage caused by Nilgai and stray animals. Financial assistance will be provided to the farmers by the Rajasthan government for fencing their fields.

schemename: Fawara Sanyantra
briefdescription: Under the Fawara Sanyantra Through this scheme, the government will provide subsidies to farmers to install sprinkler plants. This will save water and farmers will also be able to irrigate their fields through sprinklers.

schemename: Khet Talai
briefdescription: Under the Khet Talai scheme, the Rajasthan Government gives subsidies to the farmers on the construction of farm ponds so that the farmers can collect rainwater and irrigate their fields by making farm ponds in their fields.

schemename: Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram
briefdescription: In "Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram" Rajasthan government will provide subsidies to farmers on purchasing irrigation pipelines. So that farmers can get rid of the problem of irrigation. And their income can increase.

schemename: Integrated Farming in Micro Watershed Scheme
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to promote integrated farming activities for improved livelihood in a complementary manner.

schemename: Fodder Minikits under Integrated Fodder Development Scheme (General Category)
briefdescription: The scheme “Fodder Minikits under Integrated Fodder Development Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry, Government of Gujarat to provide an improved variety of fodder seeds to beneficiaries for widespread publicity, demonstration, and adaptation by farmers.

schemename: Pashu Bima Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme 'Pashu Bima Yojna' was launched by the Directorate of Dairy Development, Government of Bihar. The scheme aims to provide insurance security to farmers against the financial loss caused by cattle death and to improve the rural economy.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana
briefdescription: The "Mukhyamantri Pragatisheel Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana" is an initiative under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" aimed to encourage the trend of rearing indigenous breed of cows with high quality and productivity in the state & motivate cattle farmers for breed improvement of cows, their better care.

schemename: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General) under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
briefdescription: Under this scheme, an unemployed resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of livestock, provided they have taken a loan for establishing a 10+1 Piggery unit or a 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.

nodalministryname: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemename: Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for sheep and goat
briefdescription: Under the Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for Sheep and Goat Scheme, the Central Government will provide assistance for the establishment of frozen semen production laboratories for goats and liquid semen production laboratories for sheep at the regional level.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Svadeshi Gau Samvardhan Yojana
briefdescription: The "Mukhyamantri Svadeshi Gau Samvardhan Yojana" under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" aims to enhance milk productivity and per capita milk availability in Uttar Pradesh by encouraging the purchase of indigenous improved breed cows from outside the state and employment opportunities in rural areas.

schemename: Matsya Pokhari Yojana
briefdescription: The "Machha Chasa Pain Nua Pokhari Khola Yojana (Matsya Pokhari Yojana)" aims to boost fish production in Odisha by creating new water bodies through pond excavation. It targets income generation & employment via freshwater aquaculture. Subsidies are available for pond areas between 0.2 to 2 hectare

schemename: Organizing Block Demonstration
briefdescription: The “Organizing Block Demonstration” scheme provides a 50% subsidy or ₹2,000/- (whichever is less) on input costs for demonstrating the cultivation of Pulses crops over 5 hectares.

schemename: Distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus
briefdescription: The "Distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus" scheme provides subsidies for the distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus (NPV) to farmers raising seed farms with Pulses crops.

schemename: Quality Paddy Seed Distribution
briefdescription: The “Quality Paddy Seed Distribution” Scheme offers a subsidy of ₹5/- per kg on certified paddy seeds.

schemename: Production of Certified Seeds of Maize
briefdescription: The "Production of Certified Seeds of Maize" scheme, aims to promote the production of certified maize seeds by providing subsidy to farmers in select districts of Tamil Nadu.

schemename: Training to Farmers
briefdescription: The scheme “Training to Farmers” provides training to maize farmers across various districts, aiming to enhance farming practices and increase productivity.

schemename: Distribution of Gypsum-Oil Seeds
briefdescription: The "Distribution of Gypsum-Oil Seeds" scheme provides a subsidy on the cost of gypsum material and transportation cost, to farmers who produce and supply Foundation and Certified Class seeds.

schemename: Distribution of Manually Operated Plant Protection Equipment
briefdescription: The "Distribution of Manually Operated Plant Protection Equipment" scheme provides farmers with a subsidy of 50% on the cost of equipment to enhance agricultural practices.

schemename: Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU
briefdescription: The scheme "Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU" offers grants to farmers for maize cultivation. Farmers can avail a subsidy for demonstrating cultivation practices on a 1-hectare plot.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Anjeer Vikas Yojana
briefdescription: The Scheme aims to expand plantain cultivation across all districts in Bihar. Farmers can receive subsidies for up to 10 acres and access high-quality tissue-cultured plants for cultivation.

schemename: Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme
briefdescription: The "Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme" by the Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000 per month to each Gram Panchayat for operational and maintenance purposes, ensuring efficient governance at the grassroots level.

schemename: Nariwal Paudha Vitaran Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aimed at promoting coconut cultivation in non-traditional areas like Bihar. Under this scheme, farmers and urban residents can obtain coconut saplings at a subsidized rate to encourage widespread plantation and utilization.

schemename: Fal Podharopan Yojana
briefdescription: The objective of this scheme is to expand the area under fruit plantation in the district and increase the fruit production. This scheme is implemented in all the 52 districts of the state.

schemename: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme "Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana" aims to provide socio-economic security to livestock farmers in the state by covering livestock under an insurance scheme. Financial protection against the risk of loss due to animal death is extended to livestock owners.

schemename: Scheme of Providing Assistance to Encourage Farmers for Adoption of Organic Farming
briefdescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to promote organic farming by providing financial assistance to farmers for certification, input subsidies, and residue testing.

schemename: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter scheme
briefdescription: The "Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, is designed to help farmers reduce fodder wastage and improve their dairy farming efficiency.

schemename: Farm Storage Structure Scheme
briefdescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to help farmers to protect their harvested crops from damage due to natural calamities and store them safely for better financial returns by selling at optimal prices.

schemename: To Assist the Farmers for Construction of Community Base Water Tank/Storage Structure for Efficient Use of Water Through Drip Irrigation
briefdescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for constructing community-based water tanks/storage structures to ensure efficient water use through drip irrigation.

schemename: Crop Input Subsidy to the Farmers for Crop Loss Due to Natural Calamities
briefdescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat who suffer crop losses due to natural calamities, based on crop damage surveys conducted by the district administration.

schemename: Planning for Best Livestock Keeper's Award Function
briefdescription: The "Planning for Best Livestock Keeper's Award Function" scheme by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department honors outstanding pastoralists in Gujarat by awarding them at Taluka, District, and State levels for their excellence in animal husbandry.

schemename: Scheme to Encourage Farmers to Add Value to Crops
briefdescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers across Gujarat in adding value to their crops by providing financial assistance for purchasing machinery.

schemename: Chief Minister Small and Marginal Farmers Older Pension Scheme
briefdescription: The "Chief Minister Small and Marginal Farmers Older Pension Scheme" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide financial assistance to elderly small and marginal farmers.

schemename: Special Livestock Insurance Scheme
briefdescription: "Special Livestock Insurance Scheme" is a welfare initiative targeting SC families engaged in livestock rearing. The scheme provides free insurance for livestock, enhancing the economic security of resource-poor SC families. The scheme covers milch animals, sheep, goats, pigs, camels, etc;

schemename: Arka Vertical Garden
briefdescription: "Arka Vertical Garden" aims to promote vertical gardening in urban and peri-urban areas to increase self-sufficiency and produce pesticide-free vegetables. The scheme provides subsidized vertical garden structures to help families grow their choice of vegetables using vertical space.

schemename: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana
briefdescription: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tons, supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY.

schemename: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity Haryana
briefdescription: The subsidy for 10-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 10 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

schemename: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana
briefdescription: The subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

schemename: Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)
briefdescription: The scheme "Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)" by the Renewable Energy Department, Haryana, aims to promote the use of solar energy for domestic water heating by providing a financial subsidy to the residents of Haryana and Haryana Government employees residing in Chandigarh.

schemename: Assistance for Area Expansion of Spice Crops
briefdescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers for the area expansion of spice crops, including seed and rhizomatic spices, to enhance spice production in Gujarat.

schemename: Assistance Program for Expansion of Fruit Crop Cultivation
briefdescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for expanding fruit crop cultivation like mango, banana, papaya, etc., through intensive and ultra-intensive farming methods.

schemename: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide a subsidy per unit for purchasing insulated vehicles for the beneficiaries to promote cold-chain logistics in fish transportation.

schemename: Assistance Program for the Cultivation of Lotus Fruit (Dragon Fruit)
briefdescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers to support the cultivation of dragon fruit (lotus fruit), with higher benefits for SC/ST and priority for small-scale and women farmers.

schemename: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on 1st Year Lease Money
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and to uplift these families by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas.

schemename: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance
briefdescription: The scheme aims to promote sustainable aquaculture by reducing financial risk of shrimp farmers through subsidized insurance coverage.Under this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided on insurance premium paid by eligible fish farmers for shrimp crop insurance, helping them mitigate potential crop losses

schemename: Development of Strawberry Cultivation
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide farmers with quality and improved varieties of strawberry planting materials so as to encourage area expansion under this crop such that commercialization horticulture under this crop is achieved.

schemename: Reimbursement/ Spot Exemption of Sales Tax on High-Speed Diesel Oil
briefdescription: The scheme "Reimbursement/ Spot Exemption of Sales Tax on High-Speed Diesel Oil" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" introduced to reimburse the sales tax on high-speed diesel oil used by the registered mechanized boat operators.

schemename: Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State
briefdescription: “Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State” is a scheme by the Dept of Fisheries, Govt of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the active fishermen who contribute to the Fishermen Corpus Relief Fund, whose fishing vessels are damaged or lost due to natural calamities.

schemename: Assistance for Installation of Sprinkler / Drip Micro Irrigation Systems
briefdescription: Through this scheme, the Marginal Farmers, Small farmers, Scheduled Caste/ Schedule Tribe Farmers, Women Farmers, Big Farmers and Institutions are provided with a subsidy on the total cost or ₹ 25,000/‐ per hectare whichever is less for the installation of Sprinkler / Drip Micro Irrigation Systems.

schemename: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
briefdescription: “Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Sinking Tubewell" was launched by Dept of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, UT of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the farmers from the SC Category are provided with a grant of 90% subsidy towards the construction of tubewell/filter points per individual.

schemename: Vegetable Development Scheme
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to promote vegetable production through HYV Seeds/ Hybrids/ Improved/ Open Pollinated seedlings, including assistance to farmers.

schemename: Regional Centre for Training and Production of Mushroom
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to train farmers in the method of mushroom cultivation and to supply quality spawn and pasteurized compost to farmers.

schemename: Plant Protection Scheme
briefdescription: The objective of the scheme is to control pests and diseases including weeds and rodents of horticultural crops by the distribution of bio-pesticides/Bio-agents and equipment at 50% subsidy.

schemename: Fruit Processing Centre
briefdescription: The objective of scheme is to disseminate technical knowhow to youth entrepreneurs, farmers & housewives through practical demonstration on importance of fruit preservation & to manufacture quality processed fruit products such as Squashes, Jams, Jelly & Juices under trade name ‘Meg Fruits Product'.

schemename: Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme
briefdescription: “Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, the amount equivalent to the actual VAT paid shall be reimbursed to the owner as a subsidy on H.S.D. Oil consumed by the fishing vessel.

schemename: Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites (Gill Net/ River Gill Net with Accessories)
briefdescription: “Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided to the fishermen of Goa for the purchase of fisheries requisites (gill nets with accessories).

schemename: Financial Assistance to Take up Value Addition to Seafood
briefdescription: Through this scheme, individuals who have been residents of Goa for the last 15 years, and are interested in setting up a unit for value-added fisheries products are provided financial assistance as a subsidy of 50% of the cost for the Construction or Renovation of the Unit/ Purchase of Equipment.

schemename: Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms
briefdescription: “Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for the construction and renovation of the Farm, for the purchase of farming equipment, and the purchase of feed.

schemename: Interest Subsidy on Loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities
briefdescription: “Interest Subsidy on Loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. The bonafide agriculturist, individual of the animal husbandry/fisheries sector from Goa are provided a loan of upto ₹ 5,00,000 for the purpose of Agriculture and Allied Activities.

schemename: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories
briefdescription: “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories” is a scheme by Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Under this Scheme financial assistance is provided as a subsidy on the purchase of barrier nets and accessories for the fishermen. The applications are accepted offline.

schemename: Assistance to General Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
briefdescription: “Assistance to General Farmers for Sinking Tubewell" was launched by the Dept of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, UT of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the farmers from the General Category are provided with a grant of 65% subsidy towards the construction of tubewell/filter point per individual.

schemename: Production Incentive / Back-Ended Subsidy for Cultivation of Horticulture Crops
briefdescription: Through this scheme, the farmers who possess farmer's identity cards / authenticated land records/documents are provided with One-Time Assistance/ Bi‐Annual Assistance/ Annual Assistance for the Cultivation of Horticulture Crops such as Mango, Guava, and Sapota.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
schemename: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)
briefdescription: The scheme "Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)" is a Sub-Scheme of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom by the Spice Board, Department of Commerce and Industry, Ministry of Commerce.

schemename: Krushy Aranya Protsaha Yojane (kapy)
briefdescription: The Karnataka Forest Department launched 'Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane (KAPY)' in 2011-12 to encourage farmers and the public to increase forest and tree cover by providing subsidized seedlings and monetary incentives for planting

schemename: Agricultural Extension
briefdescription: Extension Division endeavours towards successful implementation of Agricultural Extension activities. Through its various programmes, schemes and activities, Extension Division helps farmers to get information regarding scientific research and new knowledge in agricultural practices.

schemename: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Yojana
briefdescription: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Yojana (MMKSY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat to empower women farmers in the state. The scheme was announced in the 2018-19 budget and is being implemented by the Department of Agriculture and Co-operation.

schemename: Soil Testing Laboratory
briefdescription: Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare Department launched the "Soil Testing Laboratory" scheme for the farmer on 01 April 2013.

schemename: Feed And Fodder Entrepreneurship Scheme
briefdescription: It was launched by Union Government in 2014, and focused on supporting farmers in producing fodder from non-forest wasteland/grassland and cultivating coarse grains

schemename: Price Support Scheme
briefdescription: The Government's price policy for agricultural commodities seeks to ensure remunerative prices to the growers for their produce with a view to encourage higher investment and production and to safeguard the interest of consumers by making available supplies at reasonable prices.

schemename: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ Unit For Scheduled Caste
briefdescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ unit for Scheduled Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Schedule Caste People of the society.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana” was launched by Dept. of Agriculture, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh by merging 3 ongoing protection-based Departmental schemes namely Sour Badhbandi, Anti-Hail Net Structure & Green House Renovation into single scheme having a common objective.

schemename: Agricultural Skill Development Training Programme For Women Farmers And Farmers
briefdescription: The scheme “Agricultural Skill Development Training Programme for Women Farmers and Farmers” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

schemename: Beej Swalamban Yojna
briefdescription: Mukhyamantri Beej Swavalamban Yojana was started in the year 2017-18 with the objective of producing quality improved seeds on their farms for their own use by the farmers.

schemename: Zero Budget Natural Farming
briefdescription: The Rajasthan State government started a scheme "Zero Budget Natual Farming" in 2020-21 to promote  natural farming.

schemename: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For General Category People
briefdescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for General Category People” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

schemename: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm For Schedule Caste
briefdescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm for Schedule Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide supplementary income to Schedule Caste People of the society.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemename: National Mission on Natural Farming
briefdescription: To motivate farmers to adopt chemical free farming and enhance the reach of natural farming, the Government has formulated National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF) as a separate and independent scheme from 2023-24 by up scaling the Bhartiya Prakritik Krishi Paddati (BPKP).

schemename: Kisan Samriddhi Yojana - Chhattisgarh
briefdescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Kisan Samriddhi Yojana" for farmer.

schemename: Pashu Palan Yojana (GTKVN)
briefdescription: The scheme aims to enhance the livelihoods of Thakor and Koli communities by providing financial assistance for animal husbandry activities such as dairy farming. Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹1,00,000/- are provided for the purchase of milch animals such as cows and buffaloes.

schemename: Planting Assistance Program for Hybrid Seeds of Vegetable Crops
briefdescription: This scheme offers financial assistance to farmers for the plantation of hybrid seeds and promotion of natural farming in vegetable crops across Gujarat.

schemename: Sub mission on Seeds and Planting Material
briefdescription: The scheme aims to increase the production of certified/quality seed; strengthen Seed Testing Laboratories; assist Seed Producing Institutes for the adoption of new technologies, ensuring farmers get quality seeds at the right time and reasonable prices.

schemename: Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Trible Area)
briefdescription: The scheme "Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Tribal Area)" aims to enhance agricultural productivity by financially supporting co-operative irrigation societies in tribal areas through the installation of water distribution infrastructure.

schemename: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Inputs for Freshwater Aquaculture - Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to increase inland fish production and employment through reservoir-based fish farming. The scheme offers financial assistance to individuals and groups via the iKhedut portal.

schemename: Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)
briefdescription: The scheme "Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)" is a centrally sponsored scheme that aims to promote growth in the horticulture sector through financial and technical support to farmers for cultivation, post-harvest management, and market linkage development.

schemename: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to strengthen aquaculture through fish feed production. It provides a grant per unit to the beneficiaries under PMMSY.

schemename: Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)
briefdescription: The scheme "Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)" aims to encourage tribal farmers to bring their produce to market committees by providing financial assistance towards transportation costs.

schemename: Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed
briefdescription: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed" aims to promote natural farming and hybrid seed cultivation through financial assistance to farmers. The scheme provides up to ₹20,000 per hectare to encourage sustainable agricultural practices.

schemename: Whale Shark Conservation Programme
briefdescription: The scheme aims to protect the endangered Whale Shark, the world's largest fish, along the Gujarat coast, a crucial breeding site. It mitigates threats from fishing by providing compensation for damaged nets and cultivates a strong conservation ethic among local fishermen and the broader public.

schemename: Assistance for Establishment of On farm Storage for Sorting-Grading
briefdescription: The scheme "Assistance for Establishment of On-Farm Storage for Sorting-Grading" aims to prevent post-harvest spoilage in horticultural crops by providing financial assistance for constructing storage infrastructure and purchasing sorting-grading equipment for farmers across the state.

schemename: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Large RAS Culture System Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme provides financial assistance for various inland fisheries activities, including the establishment of large Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), and is provided to individuals, societies, self-help groups, associations, reservoir leaseholders, and private entities.

schemename: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Medium RAS Culture System Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to enhance fish production and create employment through sustainable inland fisheries. It provides financial support to eligible beneficiaries for setting up medium-scale RAS units.

schemename: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Back-Yard Mini RAS Unit Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to enhance inland fish production and create employment. It provides subsidies to eligible beneficiaries for fish hatchery and RAS unit establishment.

schemename: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: 100% Soluble Chemical Fertilizer/Nano Fertilizer Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to help Adivasi farmers and tribal cultivators increase crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided for various agricultural inputs and equipment such as seeds, fertilizers, plant protection equipment, and pump sets.

schemename: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Plant protection pesticides Gujarat
briefdescription: The scheme aims to help Scheduled Tribe farmers and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas achieve higher agricultural crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this scheme, various tools and practices are provided to the farmers at subsidised rates.

schemename: Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy
briefdescription: The policy aims to transition Gujarat's transportation sector towards electric mobility and establish the state as a manufacturing hub for electric vehicles. It provides subsidies for electric vehicle purchases and charging infrastructure development to promote sustainable transportation.

schemename: National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)
briefdescription: The scheme "National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to promote organic farming practices through providing financial assistance for organic inputs and infrastructure support to farmers.

schemename: AGR-4 Scheduled Castes Sub-Plan for Distribution of Seeds and Fertilizers Input Kits at Subsidised Rates to Scheduled Caste Cultivators
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide subsidised seeds, fertilizers, and organic inputs to Scheduled Caste farmers to improve agricultural productivity.

schemename: Subsidy For Battery Operated Three-Wheelers
briefdescription: This scheme is introduced by the Climate Change Department, Gujarat, aims to promote the adoption of eco-friendly vehicles by providing a subsidy on the purchase of battery-operated three-wheelers.

schemename: Subsidy for Battery Operated 2-Wheelers

schemename: Nandi Shala Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to improve local cattle breeds through natural insemination. Under this, indigenous breeding bulls are provided on subsidy to livestock farmers in rural Gram Panchayats.

schemename: Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SCSP): Electrification of Wells of Scheduled Caste Farmers
briefdescription: The scheme aims to provide agricultural electricity connections on a priority basis to Scheduled Caste farmers. Benefits include electrification of wells and free domestic electricity connections for Scheduled Caste farmers and beneficiaries across Gujarat.

schemename: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)

briefdescription: The scheme aims to achieve integrated development of selected villages primarily through implementation of existing Central and State Government schemes in a convergent manner, ensuring access to quality services and infrastructure development in villages having SC population more than 40%.

schemename: Sagar Khedu Sarvangi Vikas Yojana
briefdescription: The scheme aims to improve power infrastructure in coastal taluks by addressing corrosion issues, ensuring adequate voltage, and continuous electricity supply. Benefits include reduction in motor burnout, prevention of industrial losses, and providing new agricultural electricity connections.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
schemename: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries
briefdescription: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries" by the Coffee Board, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, aims to provide growers with high-quality coffee seedlings to ensure the proper establishment of plantations.

schemename: Distribution Of Tractor Unit Under CMSGUY
briefdescription: The "Distribution of Tractor Unit" scheme is meant to revive the agricultural sector and help in doubling the farmer’s income by 2022. The government will provide one tractor along with some necessary accessories in each revenue village at subsidized rates. 10,000+ tractors will be distributed.

schemename: Crop Cluster Development Programme
briefdescription: The CCDP aims to develop organized marketing and improve the livelihoods of horticulture farmers in Baagwani Villages through on-farm and marketing support, promoting sustainable agriculture-based livelihoods.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemename: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
briefdescription: The Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY), launched in 2015, is an extended component of Soil Health Management (SHM) under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS), National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA).

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemename: National Bamboo Mission
briefdescription: Restructured National Bamboo Mission was launched during 2018-19 as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) after the historical amendment of the Indian Forest Act during 2017 to exclude bamboo out from definition of tree.

nodalministryname: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemename: Mission on Integrated Development of Horticulture- NHM and HMNEH
briefdescription: In 2014-15, the Government of India launched Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH) subsuming the ongoing schemes viz., NHM, HMNEH, CDB, NHB, CIH and NBM.

schemename: Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)
briefdescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the SC category as well as to FPOs (Farmers Producer Organizations), FPCs (Farmers Producer Companies), FIGs (Farmer Interest Groups), SHGs (Self-Help Groups), and Cooperative Societies for purchasing harvesting tools.

schemename: Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)
briefdescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the ST category as well as to FPOs (Farmers Producer Organizations), FPCs (Farmers Producer Companies), FIGs (Farmer Interest Groups), SHGs (Self-Help Groups), and Cooperative Societies for purchasing harvesting tools.

schemename: Talab Matsyiki Vishesh Sahayata Yojana (Anusuchit Jaati/Janajati/Ati Pichhada)
briefdescription: The Bihar Government's Animal and Fisheries Resources Department has introduced the "Talab Matsyiki Vishesh Sahayata Yojana (Anusuchit Jaati/Janajati/Ati Pichhada)" aims to support fish farmers by providing financial and technical assistance for pond construction, installation of necessary equipment

schemename: Pathari Kshetr Talab Nirman Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana
briefdescription: The "Pathari Kshetr Talab Nirman Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana" aims to promote fisheries by constructing ponds and setting up related supporting units in plateau-dominated districts. The initiative is designed to create new employment opportunities and provide a means of livelihood for farmers.

schemename: Farmers Interest Group (FIG)
briefdescription: The “Farmers Interest Group (FIG)” scheme supports every group of 15 farmers with grants for agricultural development. The scheme offers assistance for office equipment, training, ID cards, and district-level meetings.

schemename: Integrated Fisheries Scheme
briefdescription: The "Integrated Fisheries Scheme" by the Fisheries Division, Government of Jharkhand, aims to promote fish-duck farming and increase fish farmers' income. The scheme provides financial assistance of up to 80% for eligible SC/ST/women beneficiaries and 70% for others.

schemename: Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure: Scheme of Assistance for Strengthening the Regulation and Environmental Compliance
briefdescription: The scheme "Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to provide incentives for environmental compliance to ensure long-term economic and ecological balance.

schemename: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Setting Up Farmer Support Centers in State Market Committees and for Computerization of All Market Committees
briefdescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to establish farmer support centers at market committee levels and computerize all market committees in Gujarat.

schemename: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Equipment in Tribal Areas
briefdescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to enhance fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribes (ST) individuals engaged in inland fisheries.

schemename: Scheme to Provide Assistance to Sate Market Committees as well as Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Union to Construct Large Size Warehouse Godowns
briefdescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to State Market Committees and Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Unions for constructing large-sized warehouse godowns

nodalministryname: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemename: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
briefdescription: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in pig farming by providing a one-time capital subsidy of up to ₹30 lakh to eligible entrepreneurs and organizations to establish breeder farms.

nodalministryname: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemename: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig Breeds - Import of Exotic Pig Germplasm
briefdescription: The scheme aims to enhance indigenous pig productivity through genetic upgradation. The scheme supports the establishment of pig semen collection and processing labs and the import of exotic pig germplasm.
